captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a classic circular clothing button with a recessed center and a raised outer rim. The button features four small, circular sewing holes arranged symmetrically in a square pattern in the middle. The overall design is low-profile with flat surfaces on both the top recessed face and the bottom side.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric clothing button in OpenSCAD with a customizable diameter and height. The user should be able to specify the number of sewing holes (from 1 to 5), their diameter, their offset from the center, and the proportions of the recessed center lip and edge.
captions.factory: The script uses a main module that performs a difference operation on a base cylinder. First, it subtracts a set of sewing holes generated by conditional helper modules (oneHole, twoHoles, threeHoles, fourHoles, fiveHoles) containing translated cylinders. Then, it subtracts another cylinder translated upwards along the Z-axis to carve out the recessed center lip, with dimensions controlled by lip_ratio and edge_ratio.
